parameters.content:
## CRIT · Chase overdue invoices

**Reminders** (daily 09:00): every delivered invoice past due gets one reminder per step in config reminder_steps_days (3, 10, 21 days late), never twice for a step, never for a paid, over-paid, refunded or void invoice. **Watchdog** (hourly): invoices numbered but not delivered after stuck_after_minutes, and numbers taken with no invoice, are reported once to the billing channel.

**Clock**: a sweep reads the time once. A signed sweep request may pass data.as_of, used only when INVOICE_CLOCK_OVERRIDE=allow (tests); the schedules always use the real time. INVOICE_SCHEDULES=off stops the scheduled runs.

**State** in the data service: reminders (unique per invoice and step), a ledger claim per step and per stuck item, review items. **Retries**: 3 retries 5 s apart; writes send Idempotency-Key and X-Run-Id. Required steps that fail go to "CRIT · Alert on errors".

## 1. Start and clock
Two schedules and a signed sweep request (401, 400, 202). The clock is fixed once per run.

## 2. Reminders
Overdue, open, step reached and not sent: one claim, one email, one row per step. Early exits when nothing is overdue or due.

## 3. Watchdog
Stuck invoices and orphan numbers, each reported once. Early exit when nothing is stuck or new.

nodes.name: Receive daily reminder tick
nodes.notes: Schedule: every day at 09:00 in the workflow time zone (Asia/Manila).

nodes.name: Prepare reminder sweep
nodes.notes: A reminders sweep with the real clock. INVOICE_SCHEDULES=off stops it here (the tests start sweeps by request instead).

nodes.name: Receive watchdog tick
nodes.notes: Schedule: every hour at minute 20.

nodes.name: Prepare watchdog sweep
nodes.notes: A watchdog sweep with the real clock. INVOICE_SCHEDULES=off stops it here.

nodes.name: Receive sweep request
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/crit/invoices/sweeps: an operator or a test starts a sweep. Signed with BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Verify signature
nodes.notes: Same check as the billing intake: HMAC over the raw body, then the timestamp within 300 s.

nodes.name: Route on signature
nodes.notes: Early exit: 401 and no call.

nodes.name: Respond 401 unauthorized
nodes.notes: Answers 401 {status: unauthorized, error}.

nodes.name: Validate sweep request
nodes.notes: sweep.reminders or sweep.watchdog, optional data.as_of (used only when INVOICE_CLOCK_OVERRIDE is allow).

nodes.name: Route sweep request
nodes.notes: valid goes on, anything else gets 400.

nodes.name: Respond 400 invalid
nodes.notes: Answers 400 {status: invalid, errors}.

nodes.name: Respond 202 accepted
nodes.notes: Answers 202 {status: accepted, kind}; the sweep runs after the answer.

nodes.name: Fetch chase config
nodes.notes: Data service config "invoice-to-payment": reminder steps, stuck threshold, time zone.

nodes.name: Read chase config
nodes.notes: Fixes the clock for this run (now, or as_of when allowed) and the date in the business time zone.

nodes.name: Route by sweep kind
nodes.notes: reminders or watchdog.

nodes.name: Find sent invoices
nodes.notes: Data service invoices with status sent (delivered, not void).

nodes.name: Pick overdue invoices
nodes.notes: Due date before today. None: early exit, nothing else is read.

nodes.name: Route on overdue
nodes.notes: Early exit when no delivered invoice is past due.

nodes.name: Find payments
nodes.notes: Data service payments, to derive what is still open on each invoice.

nodes.name: Find refunds
nodes.notes: Data service refunds: a refunded invoice is not chased.

nodes.name: Find sent reminders
nodes.notes: Data service reminders already sent (one row per invoice and step).

nodes.name: Find clients
nodes.notes: Data service clients, for the reminder address.

nodes.name: Decide reminders due
nodes.notes: Per invoice: the highest step reached (config reminder_steps_days), only if neither it nor a later step was sent. Paid and refunded invoices get nothing. One item per reminder.

nodes.name: Route on planned
nodes.notes: Early exit when nothing is due.

nodes.name: Claim reminder steps
nodes.notes: Data service ledger, one claim per invoice and step (scope invoice_reminder): a step is sent at most once, also when two sweeps overlap.

nodes.name: Pick claimed steps
nodes.notes: claimed goes to send; a claim taken over from a failed or stuck run goes to review (the email may have gone out); in flight or done is skipped.

nodes.name: Route reminder claim
nodes.notes: send, review or none.

nodes.name: Send reminder emails
nodes.notes: Transactional email API POST /emails, one per item, Idempotency-Key per invoice and step. Critical.

nodes.name: Prepare reminder rows
nodes.notes: The reminder row per sent email: step, days overdue, open amount, email id.

nodes.name: Store reminder rows
nodes.notes: Data service reminders (unique invoice and step). Idempotency-Key per invoice, step and node.

nodes.name: Prepare reminder done marks
nodes.notes: Ledger done marks for the sent steps.

nodes.name: Store reminder reviews
nodes.notes: Data service review_items: the step whose state is unknown, ids and amounts only.

nodes.name: Prepare review alert
nodes.notes: One Slack message for the billing review channel listing the steps under review.

nodes.name: Post review alert
nodes.notes: chat.postMessage to REVIEW_SLACK_CHANNEL. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Prepare review done marks
nodes.notes: Ledger done marks (needs_review) for the steps under review, so they are not claimed again.

nodes.name: Mark reminder steps done
nodes.notes: Data service ledger: each step done with its outcome. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Summarize reminders
nodes.notes: The run's final item: date, clock source, what was sent or skipped and why. Ids only.

nodes.name: Find all invoices
nodes.notes: Data service invoices, all statuses.

nodes.name: Find taken numbers
nodes.notes: Data service invoice_numbers: every number taken from the sequence.

nodes.name: Find stuck work
nodes.notes: Invoices still issued (not delivered) and numbers with no invoice row, older than stuck_after_minutes. None: early exit.

nodes.name: Route on stuck
nodes.notes: Early exit when nothing is stuck.

nodes.name: Claim stuck reports
nodes.notes: Data service ledger, one claim per stuck invoice or number (scope stuck_report): each is reported once.

nodes.name: Pick new reports
nodes.notes: Keeps the newly claimed ones and builds one alert. None new: early exit.

nodes.name: Route on new reports
nodes.notes: Early exit when everything stuck was reported before.

nodes.name: Post watchdog alert
nodes.notes: chat.postMessage to REVIEW_SLACK_CHANNEL: invoice ids, numbers and ages. Critical: if it fails, the claims are released and the next run reports again.

nodes.name: Prepare report done marks
nodes.notes: Ledger done marks for the reported items.

nodes.name: Mark reports done
nodes.notes: Data service ledger: each report done. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Summarize watchdog
nodes.notes: The run's final item: what was found and reported. Ids only.
